# Results (generated by `python experiments.py`)

Costs are minutes per person per visit (waiting + inconvenience of going away from one's preferred time). Synthetic data. Intervals are 95% confidence half-widths over random seeds.

## E1 Small games

|   shared counter |   no information (mixed Nash) |   private coin (CE) |   optimum |   mixed_peak_prob |
|-----------------:|------------------------------:|--------------------:|----------:|------------------:|
|              3.5 |                             3 |                 2.5 |       2.5 |               0.5 |

Traffic light: best correlated equilibrium gives each driver 5.25; the best symmetric Nash outcome gives 4.67. Learning: regret matching ends 0.0045 from the CE set, Hedge 0.0180 from the coarse-CE set.
